notes.title: Finally, targetting fixed
notes.notes:
So, targetting and some bugs are fixed.

The old targetting system was like 11 dimensional math I had to do for each new ship or building I made.

The new targetting system is better, and has some small issues, but good for now until we make it better.

------------

What is really exciting is that this is the last major patch we had to do before starting on working on this unique MMO with TONS AND TONS of stuff, some of which no other MMO has such as:


1) Unlimited action players in the same zone allowed by networking, only 3d rendering is a bottleneck.

2) Fun Pulpy Criminals that you want to take out.

3) A 4x system, but you're not emperor, they're all bots.  They war against each other, and you have to deal with the consequences and join who's side you like or is paying well.  This is the beginning of a whole new style of game, where all the NPCS are interacting with each other and form companionships and get grudges etc.

4) On top of that, a Grand Space Opera driven by a LIVE GAME MASTER system.  You can literally change the landscape permanently. You can have your name etched in the history of the Universe, or in Crime Logs. Etc etc.  Live Game Master games NEVER EVER EVER get boring, unlike traditional MMOS that once you see everything, that's it, look for a new game or update.  This game can last forever, and doesn't need new players every 10 years to keep going.

5) A first person shooter style game will be added sort of like Fall out with lots of skills.

6) Customize your player by choosing race (No avatar fun), and getting stats assigned.  Later you can change characters, and the old ones you had still play along side you like crew!  If I get fancy, maybe I can make it remember some of your character's mannerisms for faux role play sayings.

7) There is a talent tree that allows you to take all sorts of different paths to upgrade your character.

8) Unlimited leveling, but power ends up being a curve with diminishing returns so hard core players don't have too too much advantage on people who spend a couple hours each night.

9) Trading

10) Allegiance system so if you follow someone, they gain some experience when you do, and the expectation is that they help you with resources.

11) Phantom Enemies: Enemies only seen on your client, they are spirit fighters who only exist on your dimension.  This helps so other players don't clear zones with nothing for you to shoot at.

12) Explore the ground of planets, literally to scale.  You could spend years walking around Mars for instance.

So many many other things coming.   The earliest will probably be 3 months from now. I'm actually looking for world builders on top of the guys who say they want to work. I find maybe 1/20 people who say they want to work actually work, so I could use many many people.  Just leave a comment below if you want to help make Worlds for this game.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello,

Those mouse bugs we found before Thanksgiving. I got around to fixing a bunch of them.   Using mouse as a controller is getting better.  I need to make it so you can move your stations with a mouse, and to pan around your base.  Right now you can only do that with keyboard/Xbox360 Controller.

Things look very good for mass updates on this game.  We will be pushing ahead at about 10x dev pace.

,Jim

notes.title: Happy Thanksgiving patch (Patch not Thanksgiving Themed)
notes.notes:
Happy Thanksgiving, and do not expect flying turkey capital ships.

This patch is preparing for a close friend and partner to join development with me.  Not only will he clean up the UI and bugs, he will keep me focused to keep devving this game.  So basically development pace just increased by 5-10x as much.  Expect big things.

In joining, he uncovered bugs with the mouse base control.  Basically mouse control was tacked on.  The real control is aimed at Xbox360 controllers and also Keyboard.  Those have no known bugs.  But Mouse was tacked on and not well play tested.  Do not use the mouse if you can avoid it.  It will lead to bugs.  The next patch will address this, but we just discovered them now and it is the holiday.

I still want a soonish patch to have the story line mission play.

Then I want to do Galaxy Conquering Strategy where combat resolution is in game.

There are big things planned.  I hope you stay on board with us over the next several months.

,Jim

notes.title: Price being lowered and reasoning
notes.notes:
Hello,

Once this game goes free to play, everyone who had an account prior will get bonus Triderium more than if they purchased it.

Until then, it would be nice to have more play testers.  I cannot simply make it free in case we get swamped and cannot pay server expenses.

This move makes perfect logical sense.

I'm polishing and patching steadily.

I look forward to adding mission mode which will be a major update in hopefully a few weeks.

,Jim

notes.title: Patch 11/14/2018
notes.notes:
Fixes:

Easy/Normal/Hard needs unlocked for your safety as a new player.

Mouse controls.

Turret AI updated so they don't get punked (Don't get too close)

Missions being added soon.  The script is good so far.

Another developer getting added possibly. He is a cool dude. He wants to make UI.

God bless,
Jim

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

Been a few weeks since last patch.

I was working on two other projects: Battlemon which will come to Android next Spring, and CrystalFighter which is a labor of love.

This Starfighter General too is a labor of love.

This patch is mostly bug fixing and polish.

I'm doing playtesting and polish.

I didn't want to make my base and fleet too big to be intimidating.  Then I realized doing that helps me play test and make the game better.  So guess what? I'm like the end boss now >:).

If I stop finding things to polish and upgrade, I'll sit down and script the storyline and first 50 missions.   Things look good moving forward.

God Bless.  Be good and loving.

,Jim

notes.title: Leaderboards in
notes.notes:
Hello,

Another feature in.

We're actively developing.  Hopefully I'll keep devving this game for years.  I find the game fun now, but so much more will be added.

Next up I think we'll do something fun.
I think next will be missions.

This means there will be characters and a pulpy story line.

That's what I want to do next.

Other things I want before promoting the game heavily:
1) Fleet Management
2) Achievements

,Jim

notes.title: Major Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Base raiding now allows you to raid player bases.
This bug flew under the radar far too long.

Leaderboards coming shortly.  I might get em in a day or two.

,Jim

notes.title: Minor fix
notes.notes:
The use of triderium works more than it did before.
I compiled the wrong scene before.
That bug is fixed once I realized it was there.

Right now, I'm working on scripting the first 50 missions.
It should be a fun story line.

,Jim

notes.title: Mouse Support enabled
notes.notes:
Hello,

Mouse support until now was not tested.
I figured many people would use it when figuring out controls.
So I debugged it and it works reasonably.

Here is my development course:
Leaderboards
Achievements
Fleet Management
Missions

Then we'll keep updating from there.

,Jim

notes.title: Planned updates
notes.notes:
I want to do storyline and missions.

I want to do fleet management to order, upgrade and pick which ships go into battle.

I want to add achievement.

I want to add leaderboards.

This will all take time...

,Jim

notes.title: This Update is some bug fixes
notes.notes:
I got a couple bugs squashed this patch.

Future update ideas:
Fleet management and individual ship upgrades
Leaderboards
Virtgoods
Missions

notes.title: Still updating this game
notes.notes:
Hey,

I feel like updating this game very often over the course of my life.

I just added the ability to add a Twitter Handle.

Yes, I know Twitter censors anyone they want, but if you have Twitter, get some prizes.  For now its just in game prizes, but as I get revenue, I'll give out In Real Life stuff maybe.

Well link your Twitter handle, get your 25 triderium.  I recommend upgrading your Triderium Reactor.

Next up should be leaderboards and then virtual goods purchasing.

God bless you guys for chilling with me and playing,

Jim

Even if you aren't playin, God bless, protect and heal you and yours and theirs.

notes.title: Upcoming features being added
notes.notes:
Hello,

I am here to discuss the upcoming features I have planned.

1) The next update will fully enable Triderium spending.  You can spend triderium on some stuff now.   You get triderium by leveling your Command Center to 7, and building a triderium reactor.

2) I want the ability for people to buy Triderium via virtual goods for busy people who work a lot and have less time to grind.

3) I want to add Leader Boards.

4) I want to add Twitter game show prizes where you can win Triderium in game or maybe even win physical loot via snail mail.

5) Once that is done, I want to add missions and a story line.

,Jim

notes.title: Another patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

In this patch, we balance triderium mining rates, and quicken Mining Operations build times levels 19+.

Also Triderium should be functional again.  A few bugs crept into last build that were fixed.

,Jimmy

notes.title: Triderium Functionality Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

Triderium as a resource is now being enabled.

If you are missing Xmatter or Scrap, it will cover the cost.

If you want to rush a building, it will cover the time.

1 Triderium is up to 2500 Xmatter or 100 scrap or 10 minutes of time.

I need to enable it to be used in researching and ship building.

A good strategy though is not spending it for quite some time and focus on upgrading your Triderium Reactor so you farm it faster.

,Jim

notes.title: Triderium update going in
notes.notes:
Triderium is a hard to come by resource you gain from your triderium reactor which can be upgraded to produce it at a higher rate.

1 Triderium can cover the costs of deficient scrap, Xmatter or even time costs

I will start giving out bonus triderium to anyone with an account.  All you need to get bonus triderium from here moving on forward is to hav a copy of Starfighter General, login just once until you see space and your command center then you will qualify.  I want people who start early to get some small bonuses for believing in me and the project.  Get a copy today and come along for the journey.

This version active now has a highscore tied to The Last Stand.  Try and beat your high score.  

It has some minor UI tweaks.  Command center level 1 makes a factory instead of a hangar.  Alert text no longer is unreadable in some situations.

,Jim

notes.title: The Last Stand is in!
notes.notes:
The best of your fleet with some militia recruits goes against the AI Planet's never ending fleet.  How long can you last?  You get to keep all the scrap you can get.   This is a really cool mode where you do a 50 vs 50 space ship battle with reinforcements.

When leaderboards come out, there will be three leaderboards:
1) Raid ELO
2) Base ELO
3) Most Scrap Collected in one Last Stand

Since it is such a valuable trove of scrap, you can do Last Stand only once every four hours for now.

,Jim

notes.title: Turret Update
notes.notes:
Minor upgrade: Turrets now visually aim and track you.  You can dodge lasers by making the turret not get angled to you.  Before it always aimed where you were going to be.   The Visuals are much better.  This is a good update, but minor.  

I believe tomorrow I want to put in the new mission choice: Last Stand.

You fight an ever coming onslaught of enemy fighters, destroyers, capital ships, and maybe even some unexpected stuff.   That's the plan for tomorrow.

It will probably start off as all fighters.

,Jim

notes.title: Hope you had a good 4th of July
notes.notes:
Improvements: Crosshairs!

Fixed some bugs....

Cross hairs!

Game is stable...

Crosshairs!


It might sound silly, but crosshairs actually make me enjoy this game even more.

notes.title: many many updates and patches
notes.notes:
I'm doing like 2-4 patches a day now with all the bug fixes, features added, smoothness of flow, balance, etc etc.  I think all the fires are out except the mainmenu having issues with stuck buttons which I can casually take a poke at, but doesn't slow the game down.

You now start with two wingmen.

The normal/easy/VeryEasy/Hard Buttons actually do something relevant to their names.

Hangars now limit how many ships you can make.

Here is my rough todo list:
1) Fix Stuck Buttons in MainMenu
2) Establish a good backup solution.
3) Leader Boards
4) Redo a speedrun video
5) Last Stand epic encounter
6) Turrets look more graphically pleasing
7) Fleet organization, upgrading individual stats, and choose the ship you fly.
8) Targetting/Radar
9) Put a targetting crosshair up

I am reconsidering even if I want to do missiles.  They seem cheap.   Like a barrage of nearly undodgeable damage up front.

I do still want to do bomber's charge shot that does a line that goes long range and makes an AOE ball... Good for siegeing bases.

Anyway, still super active on this project 4-8 hours a day.  Jump on board.  The main thing slowing me down from deving more is that I'm addicted to playing this game.  Well a thoroughly playtested game is good too.

notes.title: Important patch
notes.notes:
This patch allows you to fly higher tier ships if you researched and built them.   It also is much higher speed because I had a bug before limiting the speed.

Over all this is very fun now!

I work 6 days a week on patching this.  I had on average 2 patches/day this past week.

Get a copy and start working on your base so you're strong as awesome updates happen.

New Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V21dIw-q0EM

,Jim

notes.title: Graphics better this patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

We're patchin 2-3 times a day lately.
I'm trying to get rid of bugs as I add features.

One of the features I want to add soon is the ability to assemble your fleet offensively and defensively.

I want to add the ability to upgrade individual stats of ships soon too.

There are some Starfighter General Youtube Videos if you search for: GoodNewsJim

I hope you're stoked to be on this journey. I want to keep growing this game.

God bless,
Jim

notes.title: Updates for days
notes.notes:
I added rudimentary mouse support in today.
I fixed a bunch of bugs.
I balanced stuff so it is more fun.

I look forward to a medium style update where I do a survival battle where the enemies just keep coming and getting stronger and stronger.  The test is to see how many waves you can get through.  I'll have a leader board.  This will be known as The Last Stand.

I want to post a speed run video to rapidly get to like a level 5 Command Center.

I want to add a leaderboard.

I develop for many hours each day.   This game has become a passion in and of itself.   It would be good to jump on board and watch the progression to a great game.  Today I was enjoying myself for like an hour just playing my own game. I hit that milestone today.

notes.title: Another day, another update
notes.notes:
Hello,

I am trying to update this game each day.  Yesterday I did two updates.

This version makes the beginning more fun to play with lightly challenging AI bases.

There are many bug fixes in.

Everything is going smoothly.

Later today, I plan on doing a better Trailer Video.

,Jim

notes.title: Updates like every day yo :)
notes.notes:
Hello,

This game is getting many updates.
I can't promise an update every day, but I'm shooting for that.

This version sometimes lets you know your rank for fleet raids and base defense.

This version also gives more information when you check out buildings.

This game is getting better and I just started the extensive updates.

,GoodNewsJim

notes.title: Starbase Alpha Module released
notes.notes:
Hello,

You can play multiplayer by building your base and fleet and fighting vs other players.  This is a work in progress and hopefully expect at least an update per month.  Your data will be retained.  This game has a long way to go, but is not in Alpha or Beta.  Your starbase data hopefully will always be retained.

,Jim

notes.title: Development moving alomg
notes.notes:
We're on pace for a 3-5 week release.

I want the core base and fleet building in before moving on to galactic conquest as the next module, missions, adding missles, bombs and so on.

notes.title: Starbase Alpha
notes.notes:
Build a space station with defenses
Collect and spend resources to upgrade it and expand it.
Rsearch, build and upgrade your fleet.
Fly your fleet into battle against other space stations in action oriented combat.
Raid them for resources and ladder rank.

This will be the beginning.

ETA 2-8 weeks.

Random under construction video:
www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hz6fsuVuyvg

notes.title: Big reveal in one week
notes.notes:
Hello,

I believe I'll have the next version done in 1-4 weeks.

I have a technical hurdle, but it isn't holding me back from devving.

I got the idea for this game mode at last year's ReplayFx arcade expo.  I wanted to make an old school reflex oriented twitch skill game combined with power progressing RPG.

Big reveal next Friday, tune in 5/11/2018

,Jim
